harness_location: tools/run_cross_runtime_outcome_acceptance.py lives in infiquetra-claude-plugins, NOT in this repo -- there is no tools/ directory here at all. The cutover evidence entry's argv therefore reads as a path that does not exist on this side, and anyone replaying the port's most load-bearing evidence from the codex repo root gets ENOENT. This is a SCHEMA LIMITATION, not an oversight, and it is recorded here rather than repaired: port_contract.py pins evidence `cwd` to `.` (:1236), rejects `..` traversal in argv as an unsafe path, and enforces a closed evidence key set (:1196) that admits no note field -- so the harness's real location cannot be expressed in the entry at all. Replay it as: `python3 <path-to-infiquetra-claude-plugins>/tools/run_cross_runtime_outcome_acceptance.py`, with both clones present. The harness also appears in none of the Claude repo's workflow files, so nothing runs it in CI on either side.
important_finding_not_worked_around: The plan's stated expectation (R11/#628) was that race-codex-first and race-simultaneous would stay red, leaving the 14-leg #628 baseline at 12/14. Measured this run: those two legs now PASS -- plausibly because the U3 refuse-mode admission this port added is exactly the mechanism #628's double-dispatch race needed -- but a DIFFERENT pair, handoff-negatives-claude-issued and handoff-negatives-codex-issued, is now red instead, so the pass COUNT did not improve. Measured verbatim from the matrix above: 13 of 15 legs pass. The 15th leg is port-digest, added by this port and green -- the #628 baseline was 14 legs, so 13/15 here and 12/14 there are not the same denominator and must not be compared as if they were. Root-caused: both failures are `RegistryCorruptError: unknown field(s): isolation` on lease-registry read. `isolation` is a Claude-only lease-record field from infiquetra-claude-plugins#616 (KTD2), entirely unrelated to this port's #627/#637 scope -- codex's fleet_commons/lease_broker.py `_LEASE_KEYS` has never carried it, confirmed by grep against both pinned clones. This is a genuinely new, previously-undocumented cross-runtime incompatibility this run surfaced, not a regression this port introduced and not one of the two red legs this plan predicted. Per KTD5/R12 this is reported as an upstream-relevant finding and NOT worked around here; the acceptance leg matrix above is reported verbatim.
note_on_pre_existing_failures: The 4 full-suite failures and the 1 repository-validator error all trace to one untracked file, `.claude/codex/runs/20260725T235138Z-9a8250929b67/transcript.jsonl`, picked up by the legacy-workflow-token filesystem scanner because `.claude/` is not in its excluded-top-level set. What `git stash` against the pre-U6 commit actually establishes is that the failures are NOT caused by this unit's tracked changes: plain `git stash` does not touch untracked files, so the transcript stayed on disk and the failures reproduced with the tracked diff removed. It does not establish that the file predates the session -- the file's own run-id timestamp (20260725T235138Z) does. The plan's Risk Analysis names the `.gitignore` fix as deliberately out of scope for this unit.
